MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

2. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 13

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 14

5. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 26

6. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 9

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

10. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 12
   D. 1

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 73
   C. 72
   D. 17

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²
